Only methods declared in sugar-overlay/src, or inherited from a parent declared there, are listed. A type that extends a class outside that tree, such as \RuntimeException, does not show the methods of that class.

ModalStack final class

Modals stacked in push order: the last pushed is on top, gets every key, and paints over everything beneath it.

Position enum

Overlay position constants.

Cases: TOP · RIGHT · BOTTOM · LEFT · CENTER · TOP_RIGHT · BOTTOM_RIGHT · BOTTOM_LEFT · TOP_LEFT

PHP also provides cases().

MethodSummary
yOffset(int $fgHeight, int $bgHeight): intResolve the vertical cell offset (rows from the top) for this position given the foreground and background heights. Centering truncates toward zero (upstream Go integer division); the result is deliberately unclamped (SO-11), so an overlay larger than the backdrop yields a negative offset.
xOffset(int $fgWidth, int $bgWidth): intResolve the horizontal cell offset (columns from the left) for this position given the foreground and background widths.

SgrWalker final class

The lib's ONE SGR parameter parser.

MethodSummary
static fold(string $params, array $pen): arrayFold one SGR parameter string (the bytes between \e[ and m) into the pen state. Pure: the carry comes in and a fresh state comes out.
static legs(string $params): arraySplit a parameter string into colon legs: each leg is [code, subParameterStrings]. An empty parameter string folds to one reset leg — ECMA-48 equates \e[m with SGR 0, and both old walkers read intval('') = 0 the same way.
static extendedColor(array $operands, bool $colonForm): ?intResolve an extended-color leg's operands to 0xRRGGBB, or null when the leg is malformed (unknown mode, missing operands). Non-numeric operands intval to 0 exactly as the old walkers did; out-of-range channels saturate via channel(), never wrap.
static channel(int $component): intClamp one 38;2 / 48;2 color component into 0–255, the way terminals saturate an out-of-range value — 300 paints as 255, never as the 300 & 0xFF = 44 a bit-mask would produce.
static ansiColorToHex(int $idx, bool $bright = false): int
static xterm256ToHex(int $n): intStandard xterm 256-color palette index → 0xRRGGBB: 0-7 and 8-15 map through ansiColorToHex(), 16-231 the 6×6×6 cube, 232-255 the grayscale ramp. The index is clamped into 0-255 first (channel(), as sugar-cellbuffer does): unclamped, 38;5;300 ran the gray-ramp formula to 688 per channel and returned 0x2b2b2b0, a value outside 0xRRGGBB.

Terminal overlay compositor.

MethodSummary
static new(): selfCreate a new Veil instance.

withAnimation(AnimationKind|Fade|Scale|Slide|null $animation): selfSet the animation for overlay transitions.

zIndex(): intRead-only accessor for z-index.
clickOutsideDismiss(): boolRead-only accessor for click-outside-dismiss flag.
autoSize(): boolRead-only accessor for the auto-size flag.
border(): ?BorderRead-only accessor for border chrome.
withZIndex(int $zIndex): selfSet the z-index for stacking order.
withClickOutsideDismiss(bool $enabled = true): selfSet the click-outside-dismiss flag.
withAutoSize(bool $enabled = true): selfSet the auto-size flag.
withBorder(?Border $border): selfSet the border chrome for wrapping veil content, or clear it with null.
withPosition(?Position $vertical, ?Position $horizontal, int $x = 0, int $y = 0): selfSet the vertical and horizontal position anchors for this veil.
withPlacement(Placement $placement): selfStore a placement on this veil: the anchor pair and offset a VeilStack::compositeAll() or ModalStack pass places it with. Same storage as withPosition() (which can also clear an axis); read it back with placement().
placement(): PlacementThe stored placement, an unset axis reading as CENTER (the default every stack pass applies).
withContent(string $content): selfAttach the overlay content this veil paints when a VeilStack drives it. A veil WITHOUT content acts as a backdrop-only layer: the stack pass dims (or passes through) the canvas beneath it and writes no foreground of its own.
withUntrustedContent(string $content): selfwithContent() for text you do NOT trust: before attaching, the sweep applies Sanitize::untrustedForDisplay() (SGR/OSC/C1 controls marked invisible, CRLF and lone CR folded to LF) plus stripZoneSentinels() (forged U+E000/U+E001 zone sentinels removed), then folds TAB to four spaces — the fixed cost Width itself charges a tab, NOT the cell the terminal moves to (a surviving TAB advances to the next 8-column stop). The fold keeps the compositor's width accounting from being poisoned by a byte whose painted width differs from the one Width charges. Image markers (U+E002 and up) are preserved by design.
content(): stringRead-only accessor for the stack-driven overlay content ('' = none).
withoutZoneMarkers(): selfReturn a copy whose mark() emits no zone envelopes at all.
withReducedMotion(bool $reduced = true): selfHonour the user's reduced-motion preference.
lastFullFrame(): ?stringThe FULL (non-delta) frame the last composite()/animate() emitted, or null if none has been painted through this veil's session yet.
vPosition(): ?PositionRead-only accessor for vertical position anchor.
hPosition(): ?PositionRead-only accessor for horizontal position anchor.
positionX(): intRead-only accessor for X position offset in columns.
positionY(): intRead-only accessor for Y position offset in rows.
applyBorderChrome(string $content): stringWrap content with border chrome using sugar-style Style.
isClickOutside(\SugarCraft\Core\Msg\MouseMsg $mouse): boolCheck if a mouse message is outside the veil zone.
scan(string $rendered): selfFeed a rendered output string to the internal scanner so that subsequent hit-testing can determine which zone contains a given coordinate pair.
hit(int $col, int $row): ?ZoneReturn the zone at the given terminal cell, or null if no zone contains it. Columns and rows are 1-based (sugar-mouse zone space).
lastZoneRect(string $id): ?arrayThe rect the current scan registered for $id — the focus-ring door (sugar-overlay-030): a host that carries a focused zone id can paint its ring from published geometry without owning the Scanner.
zoneRects(): arrayEvery zone the current scan registered, in the Scanner's scan order, as {id, x, y, w, h} paint rects (the same 1-based space as lastZoneRect()). Tab/arrow cycling walks this list; the ring of the selected entry is drawn from lastZoneRect(). Empty on a markerless scan.
mark(string $id, string $content): stringWrap $content with a zone marker so the scanner can later extract its bounding box.
animate(string $foreground, string $background, Position $vertical, Position $horizontal, float $progress, int $xOffset = 0, int $yOffset = 0): stringApply animation and composite the overlay onto the background.
coveredCells(string $foreground, string $background, Position $vertical, Position $horizontal, int $xOffset = 0, int $yOffset = 0): ?arrayWhich canvas cells the composite actually covers — the rect zone-lift hosts need to know which hot zones an overlay hides (sugar-overlay-012).
overflowFor(string $foreground, string $background, Position $vertical, Position $horizontal, int $xOffset = 0, int $yOffset = 0): ?arrayHow far the block overhangs the canvas — the predicate that lets a host warn BEFORE rendering a clipped modal (sugar-overlay-007).
composite(string $foreground, string $background, Position $vertical, Position $horizontal, int $xOffset = 0, int $yOffset = 0): stringComposite a foreground string over a background string.
place(string $foreground, string $background, ?Placement $at = null): stringComposite $foreground over $background at a Placement: the one placement door every other spelling routes through (composite(), centered(), animate(), the stack passes). Omitting $at uses this veil's own placement().
splitLines(string $text): arraySplit a multi-line string into an array of lines.
maxLineWidth(array $lines): intGet the maximum line width (in characters) of an array of lines.
lineWidth(string $line): intGet the display width of a single line, in terminal cells.
resetPreviousFrame(): voidReset the diff state, forcing the next composite to emit a full frame.
withoutSession(): selfReturn a copy of this veil with a fresh RenderSession.

Animation kinds for overlay transitions.

Cases: SLIDE · FADE · SCALE

PHP also provides cases().

Fade final class

Fade animation — the foreground brightens in from black as progress grows.

static new(?CubicBezier $easing = null): self

Slide final class

Slide animation — foreground enters from the anchor direction.

MethodSummary
__construct(private readonly ?CubicBezier $easing = null)
static new(?CubicBezier $easing = null): self
easedProgress(float $progress): floatThe eased scalar progress for this curve, saturating at the ends. Veil::animate() drives the scrim ramp from the SAME value the content glides on (sugar-overlay-066). The travel offsets themselves keep using the raw curve — an overshoot that slides a hair past its landing is visible in the motion and stays.
applyFrame(string $foreground, float $progress, Position $vertical, Position $horizontal): AnimationFrameThe typed per-frame result: the foreground plus the anchor-relative travel offsets to add to the composite() call (sugar-overlay-013 — the shape the untyped array form used to hide).
apply(string $foreground, float $progress, Position $vertical, Position $horizontal): arrayThe legacy array shape (public since 1.x), delegating to applyFrame() — source-compatible until the 2.0 flip. New consumers take the typed frame; the magic-key array is the compat reading, not the contract.
